description: Tiempos de semáforos en áreas de Valdivia is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Municipalidad de Valdivia. Archivos con tiempos de semáforos en la ciudad de Valdivia. Cada archivo incluye una intersección de la ciudad, con la duración en segundos de luz verde, roja y amarilla. Coverage: Municipalidad de Valdivia. The portal files it under the publisher Municipalidad de Valdivia. Its tags are semaforo. It offers 29 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2015-10-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
